/bin/zsh -lc "rtk proxy sh -c 'set -eu
R5_VENV_ROOT=\""'$(mktemp -d -t sysgrid-r5-venv.XXXXXX)"
trap "rm -rf '"\\\""'$R5_VENV_ROOT'"\\\"\" EXIT
python3.14 -m venv \""'$R5_VENV_ROOT"
"$R5_VENV_ROOT/bin/python" --version
"$R5_VENV_ROOT/bin/python" -m pip install --require-hashes --no-cache-dir -r backend/requirements.lock'"'"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk sed -n '1,300p' scripts/lib/verify-runtime.sh
rtk rg -n 'VERIFY_RUNTIME|PYTHON_BIN|SYSGRID_VERIFY' scripts/lib scripts/verify-app.sh .github/workflows/application-ci.yml"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk proxy sh -c 'set -eu
R5_VENV_ROOT=\""'$(mktemp -d -t sysgrid-r5-verify-venv.XXXXXX)"
R5_VERIFY_ROOT="$(mktemp -d -t sysgrid-r5-verify-root.XXXXXX)"
trap "rm -rf '"\\\""'$R5_VENV_ROOT'"\\\" \\\""'$R5_VERIFY_ROOT'"\\\"\" EXIT
python3.14 -m venv \""'$R5_VENV_ROOT"
"$R5_VENV_ROOT/bin/python" -m pip install --require-hashes --no-cache-dir -r backend/requirements.lock >/tmp/sysgrid-r5-verify-pip.log
SYSGRID_VERIFY_PYTHON="$R5_VENV_ROOT/bin/python" '"\\
SYSGRID_VERIFY_SYSTEM_ROOT_USER_ID=ci-system-root \\
SYSGRID_VERIFY_TEMP_ROOT=\""'$R5_VERIFY_ROOT" '"\\
./scripts/verify-app.sh
'"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk git status --short --untracked-files=all
rtk git diff --exit-code
rtk git diff --cached --exit-code
rtk git ls-files --others --exclude-standard
rtk ps ax | rtk rg 'uvicorn app.main|vite/bin/vite|playwright test' || true
rtk git check-ignore -v backend/test-results frontend/test-results frontend/test-results-v1 frontend/test-results-root-preview frontend/playwright-report frontend/blob-report frontend/llm-report.json frontend/stage34-evidence frontend/stage35-evidence frontend/stage36-evidence frontend/OUT-26_ITERATION_36_STAGE34_EVIDENCE.html frontend/OUT-26_ITERATION_37_STAGE35_EVIDENCE.html frontend/OUT-26_ITERATION_38_STAGE36_EVIDENCE.html
rtk git status --short --branch"

/bin/zsh -lc 'rtk gh --version
rtk gh auth status
rtk gh pr list --repo kimhw8084/sysgrid --head codex/sysgrid-smv1-protected-application-ci-fix-v5 --state all --json number,state,headRefName,baseRefName,headRefOid,url'

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk gh pr create --repo kimhw8084/sysgrid --base main --head codex/sysgrid-smv1-protected-application-ci-fix-v5 --title 'Qualification: application CI repository integrity repair' --body 'Temporary non-merge qualification PR for CHG-57 System Management V1 Slice 6. This PR is for pull_request-triggered Application CI evidence only and must remain unmerged.'"

/bin/zsh -lc 'rtk gh pr view 16 --repo kimhw8084/sysgrid --json number,state,isDraft,headRefName,headRefOid,baseRefName,baseRefOid,statusCheckRollup
rtk gh run list --repo kimhw8084/sysgrid --workflow application-ci.yml --limit 5 --json databaseId,status,conclusion,event,headBranch,headSha,displayTitle,url'
/bin/zsh -lc 'rtk gh run view 35682809711 --repo kimhw8084/sysgrid --job 106603223377 --log | rtk tail -60'
/bin/zsh -lc 'rtk gh run view 35682809711 --repo kimhw8084/sysgrid --job 106603223377 --log-failed | rtk tail -240'

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk gh api repos/kimhw8084/sysgrid/actions/runs/35682809711/artifacts --jq '.artifacts[] | {id,name,size_in_bytes,expired,digest,archive_download_url}'
rtk gh pr view 16 --repo kimhw8084/sysgrid --json number,state,headRefName,headRefOid,baseRefName,baseRefOid,statusCheckRollup"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk proxy sh -c 'set -eu
R5_FAILED_ARTIFACT_DIR=\""'$(mktemp -d -t sysgrid-r5-failed-artifact.XXXXXX)"
trap "rm -rf '"\\\""'$R5_FAILED_ARTIFACT_DIR'"\\\"\" EXIT
gh run download 35682809711 --repo kimhw8084/sysgrid --name application-ci-evidence-fe84e622431418f019e6549d4f9e00555af0e613 --dir \""'$R5_FAILED_ARTIFACT_DIR"
sed -n "1,200p" "$R5_FAILED_ARTIFACT_DIR/ci-evidence/ci-identity.json"
find "$R5_FAILED_ARTIFACT_DIR/ci-evidence" -maxdepth 2 -type f | sed -n "1,80p"
if rg -n -i "(GITHUB_TOKEN|TOKEN=[REDACTED_SECRET] dump|printenv)" "$R5_FAILED_ARTIFACT_DIR/ci-evidence"; then exit 1; else true; fi
'"'"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk proxy sh -c 'set -u
R5_FAILED_ARTIFACT_DIR=\""'$(mktemp -d -t sysgrid-r5-failed-artifact.XXXXXX)"
trap "rm -rf '"\\\""'$R5_FAILED_ARTIFACT_DIR'"\\\"\" EXIT
gh run download 35682809711 --repo kimhw8084/sysgrid --name application-ci-evidence-fe84e622431418f019e6549d4f9e00555af0e613 --dir \""'$R5_FAILED_ARTIFACT_DIR"
find "$R5_FAILED_ARTIFACT_DIR" -maxdepth 3 -type f | sed -n "1,80p"
'"'"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk proxy sh -c 'set -eu
R5_FAILED_ARTIFACT_DIR=\""'$(mktemp -d -t sysgrid-r5-failed-artifact.XXXXXX)"
trap "rm -rf '"\\\""'$R5_FAILED_ARTIFACT_DIR'"\\\"\" EXIT
gh run download 35682809711 --repo kimhw8084/sysgrid --name application-ci-evidence-fe84e622431418f019e6549d4f9e00555af0e613 --dir \""'$R5_FAILED_ARTIFACT_DIR"
sed -n "1,200p" "$R5_FAILED_ARTIFACT_DIR/ci-identity.json"
find "$R5_FAILED_ARTIFACT_DIR" -maxdepth 2 -type f | sed -n "1,40p"
if rg -n -i "(GITHUB_TOKEN|TOKEN=[REDACTED_SECRET] dump|printenv)" "$R5_FAILED_ARTIFACT_DIR"; then exit 1; else true; fi
'"'"

/bin/zsh -lc 'rtk gh pr close 16 --repo kimhw8084/sysgrid
rtk gh pr reopen 16 --repo kimhw8084/sysgrid
rtk gh pr view 16 --repo kimhw8084/sysgrid --json number,state,headRefName,headRefOid,baseRefName,baseRefOid'
/bin/zsh -lc "rtk gh run view 35684318046 --repo kimhw8084/sysgrid --job 106607789310 --log-failed | rtk rg -n -C 8 '✘|Error:|failed|Test timeout|expected|Received|Process completed'"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk gh api repos/kimhw8084/sysgrid/actions/runs/35684318046/artifacts --jq '.artifacts[] | {id,name,size_in_bytes,expired,digest}'
rtk gh pr view 16 --repo kimhw8084/sysgrid --json number,state,headRefName,headRefOid,baseRefName,baseRefOid,statusCheckRollup
rtk gh run view 35684318046 --repo kimhw8084/sysgrid --json databaseId,status,conclusion,event,headBranch,headSha,workflowName,url,jobs"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk proxy sh -c 'set -eu
R5_SECOND_ARTIFACT_DIR=\""'$(mktemp -d -t sysgrid-r5-second-artifact.XXXXXX)"
trap "rm -rf '"\\\""'$R5_SECOND_ARTIFACT_DIR'"\\\"\" EXIT
gh run download 35684318046 --repo kimhw8084/sysgrid --name application-ci-evidence-fe84e622431418f019e6549d4f9e00555af0e613 --dir \""'$R5_SECOND_ARTIFACT_DIR"
printf "IDENTITY'"\\n\"
sed -n \"1,120p\" \""'$R5_SECOND_ARTIFACT_DIR/ci-identity.json"
printf "TOP_LEVEL'"\\n\"
find \""'$R5_SECOND_ARTIFACT_DIR" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -print
printf "EVIDENCE_COUNTS'"\\n\"
for path in backend-test-results frontend-test-results frontend-test-results-v1 frontend-test-results-root-preview frontend-playwright-report owned-runtime; do
  if [[ -d \""'$R5_SECOND_ARTIFACT_DIR/$path" ]]; then
    printf "%s files=" "$path"
    find "$R5_SECOND_ARTIFACT_DIR/$path" -type f | wc -l
  fi
done
printf "RUNTIME_LOGS'"\\n\"
find \""'$R5_SECOND_ARTIFACT_DIR/owned-runtime" -type f -maxdepth 3 -print
printf "SECRET_SCAN_TEXTUAL'"\\n\"
if rg -n -i \"(GITHUB_TOKEN|AWS_SECRET|SECRET_KEY|PASSWORD=[REDACTED_SECRET] dump|DATABASE_URL=)\" \""'$R5_SECOND_ARTIFACT_DIR/owned-runtime" "$R5_SECOND_ARTIFACT_DIR/ci-identity.json"; then exit 1; else echo PASS; fi
'"'"

/bin/zsh -lc 'rtk gh pr close 16 --repo kimhw8084/sysgrid
rtk gh pr view 16 --repo kimhw8084/sysgrid --json number,state,headRefName,headRefOid,baseRefName,baseRefOid,mergedAt
rtk gh ls?'

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk git rev-parse HEAD
rtk git show -s --format='parent=%P tree=%T subject=%s' HEAD
rtk git diff --name-status 29d6385f38dc174327dfef475101ccfa6c6b73a1..HEAD
rtk git diff --check 72e0c551dddf9e6f3e1ab68250c4e8a3d4c15167..HEAD
rtk git merge-base --is-ancestor 3f2b592a9c7d486369ac724c8f30d1e8be9a2bd1 HEAD
rtk git merge-base --is-ancestor e7f067401a7126f7437977a3c6395100ab526737 HEAD
rtk git merge-base --is-ancestor 29d6385f38dc174327dfef475101ccfa6c6b73a1 HEAD
rtk git ls-tree -r HEAD | rtk awk '"'$1 == "160000" { print; count += 1 } END { print "tree_gitlink_count=" count + 0; if (count) exit 1 }'"'
rtk git ls-files --stage | rtk awk '"'$1 == "160000" { print; count += 1 } END { print "index_gitlink_count=" count + 0; if (count) exit 1 }'"'
rtk proxy test "'! -e .gitmodules
rtk git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main refs/heads/codex/sysgrid-smv1-protected-application-ci-fix-v5
rtk git status --short --branch
rtk git for-each-ref --format='"'%(refname) %(objectname)' refs/heads/codex-fabric/evidence/sysgrid/sysgrid-smv1-protected-application-ci-fix-v5
rtk ls -l .codex-fabric/audit.json"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk gh api repos/kimhw8084/sysgrid/branches/main --jq '{protected,protection_url}'
rtk gh api repos/kimhw8084/sysgrid/rulesets --jq '[.[] | {id,name,enforcement}]'
rtk gh api repos/kimhw8084/sysgrid/branches/main/protection --jq '{required_status_checks,required_pull_request_reviews,enforce_admins,restrictions}' 2>/dev/null || true"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk proxy git diff 29d6385f38dc174327dfef475101ccfa6c6b73a1..HEAD --binary | rtk proxy shasum -a 256
rtk python scripts/tests/test_application_ci_contract.py
rtk python -c 'import yaml; from pathlib import Path; yaml.safe_load(Path(\".github/workflows/application-ci.yml\").read_text()); print(\"workflow YAML: PASS\")'
rtk git diff --name-only 29d6385f38dc174327dfef475101ccfa6c6b73a1..HEAD | rtk awk '"'$0 ~ /''^frontend'"\\/src\\// || "'$0 ~ /''^backend'"\\/app\\// { bad=1; print } END { print \"protected_product_scope=\" (bad ? \"FAIL\" : \"PASS\"); if (bad) exit 1 }'
rtk git status --short --branch
rtk git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main refs/heads/codex/sysgrid-smv1-protected-application-ci-fix-v5"
